name: Forza Innovations Inc.
summary: Forza Innovations Inc. specializes in health-tech wearable performance solutions. Its flagship product line, the WarmUp series, comprises wearable back compression devices such as the J4 Sport, J4 X, and J4 Fitbelt. These devices are specifically designed to aid in muscle relaxation, warm-up, and to alleviate stiffness and soreness. The company adopted its current name, Forza Innovations Inc., in June 2021, having previously operated as Genesys Industries, Inc. Established in 2014, Forza Innovations Inc. is headquartered in San Diego, California.
